final: WITH account_metrics AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.district_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.district_id), region_metrics AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(am.avg_amount) as region_avg_amount, AVG(am.avg_balance) as region_avg_balance FROM account_metrics am JOIN district d ON am.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as mean_amount FROM region_metrics) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance, r.region_avg_amount / g.mean_amount as ratio FROM region_metrics r CROSS JOIN global_mean g WHERE g.mean_amount IS NOT NULL
